_comment: Antigravity MCP registration. Config lives at ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json. Deploy with: python $AI_WORKSPACE_ROOT/scripts/mcp-deploy.py --tool antigravity
_manage: Source of truth is servers/*.json. This file lists which servers are registered to Antigravity.
_status: pending — ai-workspace-docs not yet in live config
_note: Antigravity's live config also has StitchMCP and cloudrun (both disabled, Google-specific). Those are managed via Antigravity UI and are not tracked here.

stripe._note: Key is in --header arg. Deploy script expands ${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY} at deploy time.
